name: orchestrator
description: Secure local collection, root-safe file indexing, model-assisted action extraction, and SQLite schedule persistence

capabilities.name: orchestrator.collection
capabilities.description: Collect public web content through the authenticated Browser daemon and secure Fetch fallback

capabilities.name: orchestrator.file_index
capabilities.description: Index Markdown and text files into ChromaDB with canonical root ownership and root-scoped stale cleanup

capabilities.name: orchestrator.action_extract
capabilities.description: Extract structured action items from reports with explicit status and validation semantics

capabilities.name: orchestrator.schedule_store
capabilities.description: Persist action schedules in the shared SQLite runtime database

optional: browser-use through the explicit reduced-security override

credentials.description: Optional credential for action extraction and Vision enrichment

health_checks.description: Report secure collection backend readiness without exposing bearer tokens
Verify the optional file indexer imports and reports storage status

storage.description: Optional root-owned Markdown and text semantic index
Action schedule persistence shared with Scheduler
Generated collection and action review reports
